note: Editable DISPLAY NAMES for the joint-axle diagnostic overlay in dev/rig-preview.html. Purely cosmetic labels for humans to read -- safe to rename freely at any time, unlike the frozen position/pixel data in mannequin-axles.json and humanoid-art-mannequin.json, which this file never touches. 'points' is keyed by bone id (one name per axle dot). 'lines' is keyed by the bone id whose own line it is -- every bone with a parent draws exactly one line in the overlay -- and is optional per entry: leaving a bone out of 'lines' means the tool shows an auto-generated '<from> -> <to>' name instead.
